dynamicMenu.label: Go to
dynamicMenu.supertip: Jump to a group of columns (Feeds and speeds, Coolant, Tool inspection ...) on the ops you are on. The other groups fold away so the sheet is easier to read. All columns opens them again.

editBox.label: Find op
editBox.supertip: Type an op number (12), a tool (T12) or words from the comment, then press Enter. The sheet jumps to the next op that matches.

button.label: Next match
button.supertip: Jump to the next op that matches what you typed in Find op.

button.label: Changed ops
button.supertip: Show only the ops you have changed. Show all brings the rest back.

button.label: This tool's ops
button.screentip: Show the ops of this tool
button.supertip: Show only the ops that use the same tool as the row you are on.

button.label: Slowest ops
button.supertip: Show only the ops that take most of the cycle time, longest first. The place to start saving time.

button.label: Set
button.supertip: Put one value into every selected cell. The window shows how many cells will change, and which are refused, before anything is written.

button.label: Scale %
button.supertip: Make the selected numbers bigger or smaller: +10% is 10% more, -10% is 10% less. The window shows the new values before anything is written.

button.label: Copy from op
button.supertip: Select the cells to copy (feed, speed ...). The op you are on is copied from - or pick another. Copy into the other selected rows, or into every other op of the same tool. A feed is not copied into a row whose feed is in other units (per rev / per min) unless you copy that too.

button.label: Comments & text
button.supertip: Edit the op comment, the tool inspection comment or a manual entry's text for the ops you have selected. Double-click one of those cells to open it too.

button.label: Coolant
button.supertip: See and set the coolant for the ops you have selected - all of them at once. Works for both kinds of machine coolant setup.

button.label: Speed & feed
button.supertip: A calculator filled in from the op you are on: SFM and RPM, feed per rev and per minute, and the real chip thickness for round and lead-angle inserts. Can write the new feed back to the op.

button.label: Inspection & inserts
button.supertip: Each tool of the ops you have selected: its insert, flips per part, how long each edge cuts and how much of the last edge gets used. Suggests the edge time that uses every edge evenly - or one flip fewer or more - and sets it on every op of the tool. Tools whose flips come from the toolpath itself say so.

button.label: Hit a target time
button.supertip: Pick ops or a tool, type the time you want (12:30) or a change: -10% for 10% less time. The feeds change by one amount, each inside its own limits. Preview shows before and after for every op; Apply writes it.

button.label: Program check
button.supertip: Looks over the whole program for things worth a second look before it goes to the floor - each one with why it matters and a link to the op.

menu.label: Scenarios
menu.supertip: Save the changes on the sheet under a name, bring them back later, or compare saved ideas side by side.

button.label: Save the changes as a scenario
Undo
button.supertip: Take back the last Parameter Table command (Ctrl+Z works too). Press again to go further back. A cell you have typed over since is left alone.

menu.label: Back to the dump
menu.supertip: Put cells back to the values they had when the sheet was dumped.

button.label: List changes
button.supertip: A Changes sheet listing every cell that differs from the dump, old and new. Click a parameter to go to its cell.

button.label: Change report
button.supertip: A one-page report of what changed and what it saves - cycle time, insert flips and insert cost, per part and per batch. Ready to print.

button.label: User manual
button.supertip: Open the user manual: how each tool works, with examples.
